failures.criterion: Spec 'What changes' bullet 1 / Acceptance 1: the github row proves the session's GitHub identity under the role's own credential, so the six rows read present in every pod the daemon launches
failures.evidence: checkGitHub (packages/pi-legion/src/capability-report.ts:380-387) runs `gh api user --jq .login`. Every Legion role's gh runs on a GitHub App installation token (appauth; legion-implementer[bot]/legion-reviewer[bot]; under #1843 the token in GH_CONFIG_DIR's hosts.yml), and GitHub answers REST GET /user to an installation token with 403 'Resource not accessible by integration'. Observed twice in this pod on 2026-10-10: (a) the scratch session's ready body, with the reviewer App's real token redeemed through the pod's daemon: github ok:false 'gh api user failed: gh: Resource not accessible by integration (HTTP 403)' while the other five rows passed; (b) `legion gh -- api user --jq .login` from the tester pane → exit 1, same message, while `legion gh -- api graphql -f 'query={viewer{login}}' --jq .data.viewer.login` → legion-reviewer[bot] (the identity read the repository's own proofs use: packages/daemon/internal/api/real_github_test.go:39, scripts/e2e/stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh:579). So the github row reads open in every pod and the deployment row never reaches present; Stage 4b full-agent would fail on it. Red test: `cd packages/pi-legion && bun test src/capability-report.test.ts -t "installation token"` → 1 fail ('passes under a GitHub App installation token, the only credential a Legion role holds': expected ok true, received false), commit 8a113f75. The fix (the implementer's): read the identity with GraphQL {viewer{login}} as real_github_test.go does, and move the row's detail wording in docs/kubernetes.md:1126, packages/pi-legion/AGENTS.md:343 and packages/pi-legion/CHANGELOG.md:20 with it; the spec's 'gh api user' wording names an endpoint an installation token cannot call (for the architect).

forTheArchitect: The spec's 'gh api user succeeds under the role's own credential' names an endpoint a GitHub App installation token can never call (403 Resource not accessible by integration); the identity read is GraphQL {viewer{login}} → legion-<role>[bot], as real_github_test.go and stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh already do. A spec wording fix, if any, is yours.
